conventions.units: design units; extension y = 0 at the seam
conventions.light: from above, leaning toward the clearing column x = 470 (fx.trees.light_side)
conventions.mesh_rule: fx.paint.emit: flat < 10 u2, 2x2 < 100 u2, else 4 u cells (8 u for smooth shapes); 2x2 fitted by least squares
conventions.geometry: signed-distance unions on a 3 samples/u grid -> contours -> adaptive Catmull-Rom cubic Beziers, written as absolute M + relative c, 1 decimal
conventions.determinism: every recipe takes a seed; scene.SEED = 20261014

bell_tree.fn: fx.trees.bell_tree(cx, top, W, tiers, seed, layer)
bell_tree.structure: per tier: body shape (dark side ramp, shade band under the tier above) + lit-side shape (boundary at -0.10 of the local half-width, wavy; 14 u ramp from mid to light)

params.top_tier: H 1.8-2.0 W, dome r 0.42-0.48 W, neck 0.22, flare power 1.2-1.35
params.lower_tiers: H 1.45-1.55 W, dome r 0.5 W, neck 0.05, hem 0.72-0.8 W below the hem above
params.hem: 3 lobes (W <= 45) or 4; ellipse lobes rx = 0.56 pitch, ry = 0.85 rx; outer lobes lifted 0.18 ry and tilted 0.25 rad
params.asymmetry: flank widths +-6 % growing toward the hem

bell_tree.status: prototype; refine: tier-to-tier overlap, stronger hem shade, more painted variation in the lit region

fern_pine.fn: fx.plants.fern_pine(cx, top, W, tiers, seed, layer, halo)
fern_pine.structure: pale ground halo; per tier one rosette shape: 7-9 blunt oval leaflets on an elliptical reach profile + 3-4 front hem lobes + core ellipse; dark core shade under the tier above

params.leaflet: width 0.42 x length (max 0.27 W), blunt tip circle 0.40 width

fern_pine.status: prototype; refine: lighter front lobes over a darker core, more distinct leaflets

leaf_clump.fn: fx.plants.leaf_clump(cx, cy, R, seed, layer, n, front)
based_on: fern mounds at the bottom-left seam
leaf_clump.structure: dark inner mass; n palmate leaves fanned over the upper half (tone by depth +-0.08), `front` yellow-green leaves hanging forward; each leaf: rosette of 5-6 leaflets
leaf_clump.status: prototype; refine: rounder broad lobes, stronger leaf-to-leaf value steps, soft ground shadow

fern.structure: arching fronds = leaflet rows along a curved axis, rounded leaflets, darker toward the base; clump of 5-9 fronds

flower.fn: fx.plants.flower(cx, cy, R, kind, seed, layer)
based_on: lilac flowers near the bridge and the bottom-left rock
flower.structure: one petal shape (5 round petals + disc, paler toward tips and top), one centre (top-to-bottom yellow ramp)
flower.status: prototype; close to the live flowers

rock.fn: fx.stones.rock(cx, by, w, h, seed, layer, moss)
rock.structure: base (mid) + dark left face + darker narrow right face + light top face, slightly angular facet lines
rock.status: prototype; refine: taller dome, diagonal top-face boundary, irregular facet lines (current jag is too regular)

path.structure: cream surface mesh; pale rim on band-less edges; brown band on the outer side of each bend with smoothstep tapers; 1.2 u pale line; cobbles; pebbles (Poisson disc 78 u)
path.status: working; seam continuous in position, slope and colour (crops/stage1/seam_path_*.png)

pebble.fn: fx.stones.pebble(cx, cy, rx, ry, ang, seed, layer, palette)

ground.structure: one full-canvas mesh sampled from a paint buffer: open tone + large/small mottling, pale bank strip beside the band, pale halo strip on band-less path edges, soft object shadows and halos (Stage 2), blended into the live last row
ground.status: working base; shadows/halos per object in Stage 2

seam_caps.status: pebble cap working; tree lobes and fern mounds in Stage 2.1

layer_mapping.meadow: ground base, halos, shadows, stream bank strip
layer_mapping.pond: stream water, rims, ripples, lily pads, reeds
layer_mapping.backTrees: edge bell trees behind, old tree trunk and roots
layer_mapping.frontTrees: front bell trees, old tree canopy, seam caps of the live front trees
